name: Kestrel bonded desk

name: Quiet Orbit berth
access: The crew's Stardancer is docked here, with cargo space and equipment access.
note: A Fake Transponder and Smuggling Compartments offer options, not automatic immunity from inspection.

name: Inspection corridor
access: Manifest check and departure clearance; Inspector Hale can negotiate a medical escort.
note: A local Rin traffic corridor, not an inter-system jumpgate. Other approaches can emerge in play.

name: Lantern Clinic
access: An independent medical ship beyond the inspection perimeter, still in Rin.
note: Dr. Olan Vey can receive a living patient or consignment. Going here does not count as laying low in another system.
